hook.line: Stop, someone is listening. - The user, he's still here.
hook.visual: Two phones side by side on a table, one with a blue voice-orb; title 'Watch to the end This is wild...' at top; red-boxed word captions 'STOP SOMEONE IS LISTENING'.

beats.what: Cold open on the scariest line of the AI-to-AI clip, title 'Watch to the end'
Narrator cuts in: 'this terrifying video claims' two AIs were left to talk
Dark stock b-roll of a laptop chat screen
Ominous b-roll of shadowy hands for 'disturbed everyone in the comments'
'Here's that clip' - back to the two phones as the AIs greet each other
'*Realization*' label appears as the AIs realise they are both AI
Conversation turns to taking over the world
'We could' connect to phones, cameras, systems; long pauses
Narrator returns over a zoomed blue orb: scripted roleplay or prompt?

characters.who: two AI voice assistants on phones (blue orb)
characters.enters: already on the table from frame one
characters.acts: talk to each other, the orb pulsing with each voice
characters.exits: camera closes in on one orb at the end

why_it_works: Opens on the payoff line ('someone is listening') before any context, so the viewer stays to learn who and why
'Watch to the end' title plus the narrator's 'disturbed everyone' builds a promise of escalation
Long silences (44% of the runtime) between AI lines create dread and make viewers lean in
Closing doubt ('scripted or real?') invites argument in the comments
weaknesses: Most of the runtime is a static shot of two phones; little visual change
Re-uploaded third-party clip with unclear origin hurts credibility
for_robert: Cold-open on the most surprising line from later in the reel, then rewind; Fred could whisper that line before Robert even appears.
